description: Everything in the named-contacts product, plus the company around the person: industry, location, headcount, stage, ticker, exchange, state of incorporation and entity type, from the same two sources and the filed entity record. A real sample on every call, priced on request. No LinkedIn URL — no source here holds a per-person profile link.

buyer_contact.description: How to reach you about the quote.

dry_run.description: Return the sample and the quote without opening an order.

industry.description: Matches the filed industry description, or the cohort's industry label.

live.description: Read each company's own site during the call (default true). Adds the company's current inbox, phone and links, each with provenance.

live_budget.description: Hard ceiling on how many records get a live pass (default and maximum 25). Roughly five page fetches and two seconds each.

location.description: City, state or country. Cohort records only — filings do not carry a person's location.

quantity.description: Records wanted (1-100000). A real sample is returned now; the batch is quoted.

role.description: Matches the job title as stated on the filing (e.g. 'Chief Executive', 'Chief Financial').

source.description: 'both' (default), 'filings' for named officers with filed titles, or 'cohort' for founders with validated addresses.

name: hsh-b2b-enriched
